किल् किल्, cl. 6. P. किलति, चिकेल, केलितुम्,
to be or become white; to freeze; to
play; cl. 10. P. केलयति, -यितुम्, to send, to throw
or cast; [cf. Hib. cal, ‘a joke.’]

कील् कील्, cl. 1. or 10. P. कीलति, कीलयति,
-यितुम्, to bind; to fasten; to stake; to
pin.

1. किल, अस्, m. play, trifling.
—किल-किञ्चित, अम्,
n. amorous agitation, weeping, laughing, being angry,
merry, &c., in the society of a lover.

किल 2. किल, ind. (a particle of asseveration
or emphasis), indeed, verily, assuredly; (or of expla-
nation) namely; किल is preceded by the word on
which it lays stress, and occurs very rarely at the
beginning of a sentence or verse; according to native
lexicographers किल may be used in communicating
intelligence, and may imply ‘so said,’ ‘so reported,’
‘probably,’ ‘possibly,’ ‘agreement,’ ‘dislike,’ ‘false-
hood,’ ‘inaccuracy,’ and ‘reason.’
किल 3. किल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

कील, अस्, आ, m. f. a sharp piece of wood, a stake,
a pin, a peg, a bolt, a wedge, &c.; a lance, a pike;
a post, a post in a cow-house to which cows are fas-
tened, a pillar; a weapon; the elbow; a blow or
punch with the elbow; a blow, a thump; a blow in
copulation; flame, lambent flame; a small or minute
particle; a gnomon; a position of the fœtus impeding
delivery; an epithet of Śiva.
—कील-संस्पर्श, अस्,
m., N. of a plant, commonly Gāva, = Diospyros Glu-
tinosa, a plant, the fruit of which yields a substance
like turpentine used to cover the bottom of boats.

किलकिल किलकिल, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva; N. of a town; (आ), f. (an onomatopoetic word),
sounds or cries expressing joy or the expression of
pleasure by any sound or cry.

किलकिलाय, nom. P. किलकिलायति, to raise sounds
expressing joy.

किलाट किलाट, अस्, ई, m. f. inspissated milk,
coagulated milk; it may also be applied to cheese.
किलाटिन्, ई, m. a bamboo.

किलात किलात, अस्, m., N. of an Asura; a
dwarf.

किलास किलास, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. leprous;
(ई), f., Ved. a kind of spotted deer described as the
vehicle of the Maruts; (अम्), n., Ved. a white leprous
spot; a blotch, a scab; (in medic.) a species of leprosy
resembling the so-called white leprosy, in which
disease the skin becomes spotted without producing
ulcers.
—किलास-घ्न, अस्, m. a sort of gourd, Mo-
mordica Mixta (‘what removes leprosy’).
—किलास-
नाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. removing leprosy.
—कि-
लास-भेषज, अम्, n., Ved. a remedy against leprosy.
किलासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, leprous, having blotches.

किलिञ्च किलिञ्च, अम्, n. a thin plank, a
board; [cf. the following.]

किलिञ्ज किलिञ्ज, अस्, m. a mat; a thin
plank of green wood.

किलिञ्जक, अस्, m. a mat; a screen or twist of
grass or straw.

किलिनकिल किलिनकिल, अस् or अम्, m. or
n. (?), a various reading for किलकिल; N. of a town (?).

किलिम किलिम, अस्, m. a tree, a kind of fir
or pine, Pinus Deodar [cf. देव-दारु]; (अम्), n.
resin, the extract of the pine.

किल्किन् किल्किन्, ई, m. a horse; (also read
किन्धिन् and किल्विन्.)

किल्बिष किल्बिष or किल्विष, अम्, n. (fr. rt.
किल्?), fault, offence, sin, guilt; injustice, injury;
disease, sickness.
—किल्विष-स्पृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. re-
moving or avoiding sins or offences.

किल्विषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who commits an offence,
wicked, culpable, criminal, sinful, (often in compounds,
e. g. राज-किल्विषिन्, one who as a king commits an
offence.)
किल्विन् किल्विन्, ई, m. a horse; [cf. किल्किन्.]

कीलक, अस्, m. a pin, a bolt, a wedge; a splint
for confining a broken bone; a fence; also = शिवक,
a pillar for cows &c. to rub themselves against, or
one to which they are tied.
कीलिका, f. the pin of an axle.

कीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, staked, impaled; set up as a
stake or pole; pierced, transfixed; pinned, fastened
by a stake &c.; bound, tied, confined.

कीलाल कीलाल, अस्, m. a sweet beverage;
also a heavenly drink similar to Amṛta, the food of
the gods; honey; (अम्), n. blood; water.
—कीलाल-
ज, अम्, n. flesh.
—कीलाल-धि, इस्, m. the ocean.
—कीलाल-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking blood; (अस्), m.
a Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin or imp.
—कीलाल-पा,
आस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Agni, ‘drinking the beve-
rage Kīlāla;’ (आस्), m. an attendant of Yama, or N.
of one of the attendants of Yama.
—कीलालोधन्
(˚ल-ऊधन्), आ, ध्नी, अ, Ved. carrying the beverage
Kīlāla in one's udder.
